title: Stakeholder Signal Catalogue and Quick Effort Sampler
content:
Purpose:
This is a lightweight, ad-hoc inventory (signal catalogue) of cross-functional stakeholder asks surfaced in the last two weeks. Goal: rapid triage and a ballpark effort sampler so owners can decide quick next steps or flag for longer planning. Treat as working notes — short rows, short estimates, questions inline.

How to use:
- Scan rows, pick items you own or can champion.
- If you accept, move Status -> accepted and push a quick PR/Jira link in Notes.
- If unclear, mark Status -> needs-info and ping collaborator noted.
- We aim to keep total scoped work <= 40h for this sprint.

Table (columns): item_id | stakeholder | team | ask | priority | estimated_hours | owner | desired_by | status | notes

Rows:
1 | Platform SRE | eng-sre | Quick sampling job: add 1‑hour daily latency probe for endpoint /v1/generate in eu-west | 2 | 4 | Miguel Rivera | 2029-02-18 | accepted | Miguel will drop a lightweight Grafana panel; depends on infra creds
2 | Console PM | product-console | Add token-level cost column to per-route dashboard (small UI column + mapping) | 1 | 12 | Grace Huang | 2029-02-25 | in_review | Spike done; needs design decision on decimal formatting
3 | Sales AE | go-to-market | One-pager summary of Dedicated capacity burst guidelines for enterprise prospects | 3 | 2 | Aisha Patel | 2029-02-16 | accepted | Aisha to draft and attach to customer proposal template
4 | Privacy & Security | security-and-compliance | Confirm retention window policy for Private deployers w/ KMS rotation note | 1 | 8 | Omar Khan | 2029-02-22 | needs-info | Waiting on legal review; security lead assigned (S. Nguyen)
5 | Solutions Eng | solutions-engineering | Quick-run: sample 5 customer prompts to estimate cost delta when quantized model is used | 2 | 6 | Miguel Rivera | 2029-02-20 | accepted | Miguel to upload CSV of prompts to /tmp and share results
6 | DevRel | developer-experience | Lightweight script + README for local end-to-end minimal example (hosted API -> chat) | 2 | 10 | Grace Huang | 2029-03-01 | draft | Grace will pair with DevRel to make code idiomatic; consider TypeScript and Python snippets
7 | Product Ops | product-ops | Compile short coverage matrix of oncall owners across regions for next 2 weeks | 1 | 3 | Aisha Patel | 2029-02-17 | accepted | Use existing rota as baseline, call out gaps for APAC-evening coverage
8 | Finance | finance-and-legal | One-off: estimate incremental monthly cost if embeddings usage doubles for top 5 customers | 2 | 5 | Omar Khan | 2029-02-24 | needs-info | Finance gave raw usage CSV; need the cost-per-embedding model (linked_artifacts JIRA-8452)
9 | Observability | observability | Add a quick alert (pager) for sustained 2s p95 on small model group in us-west | 1 | 4 | Miguel Rivera | 2029-02-19 | accepted | Tweak alert sensitivity to avoid flapping; link to runbook in notes later
10 | Internal Comms | company | Short internal note announcing minor SLA tweak for Dedicated burst policy | 3 | 2 | Grace Huang | 2029-02-21 | draft | Draft in progress, waiting for legal signoff on phrasing

Quick totals and observations:
- Total estimated_hours (sum): 56h
- Items marked priority 1: rows 2,4,7,9 (sum estimated_hours 27h)
- Immediate-sprint target: prune lower-priority asks to keep sprint load <= 40h. Recommend deferring item 6 (10h) and item 5 (6h) if needed.

Open questions / flags:
- Security retention policy (row 4) needs legal input before closure — blocking other items that reference retention.
- Finance cost model (row 8) missing cost-per-embedding parameter — tag CFO analyst for quick lookup.
- Grafana creds (row 1) need temporary token with read-only metrics; Miguel has raised infra ticket.

Next steps (owner action checklist):
- Owners accept or mark needs-info within 48 hours.
- For accepted items, create light Jira ticket with 1–3 line acceptance criteria and add link to Notes column.
- If total accepted hours > 40h, convene 15-min prioritization sync (owner + PM + eng lead).

Recent changes log (small):
- 2029-02-11 created by Aisha Patel (initial harvest from slack #ops-pulse and weekly interlock)
- 2029-02-13 Miguel added rows 1,5,9 and initial notes
- 2029-02-15 Grace updated status for dashboard ask (row 2) and added UI comments

Bottom line: lightweight catalogue to triage quick cross-functional asks. Treat numbers as ballpark; escalate any item that would require >24h of coordinated planning.
